headline: Opened action on expanded network access agreement with Connecticut Education Network; no final vote recorded.
summary: Chair Foley reported that the next Technology Commission meeting is set for September 3. Year-to-date budget information for the Information Technology Department, Registrars of Voters, and Town Clerk's Office was posted online, and he is working to set up quarterly updates. The expanded network access agreement item was opened, but the minutes do not show how it ended.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
ONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
IT & CIVIC ENGAGEMENT 
COMMITTEE 
AUGUST 10, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
 Present - Doug Foley 
Committee Vice Chair: 
 Present - Grace Teodosio 
Committee Members: 
Present- Tom Figlar 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
Present- Maurine Crouch 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
 Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader  
 Present - Katie Kiely, President 
   
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
IT & Civic Engagement Committee, August 10, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was called 
to order at 9:04pm with members present as noted above.  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
Public Input was opened at 9:05pm.  No members of the public came forward to speak 
and the public input session was closed at 9:06pm. 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Chair Foley mentioned that the next Technology Commission meeting is scheduled for 
September 3 and noted that year-to-date budget information for the Information 
Technology Department, Registrars of Voters, and Town Clerk's Office had been posted 
online.  He also reported that he has been working with those departments to establish 
regular quarterly updates to the Committee. 
 
He further reported that he attended the recent Technology Commission meeting and 
noted positive collaboration between the Commission and the Town's IT Manager, as well 
as ongoing efforts to improve efficiency.   
4. ACTION ITEMS  
  1. ORDER TO APPROVE EXPANDED NETWORK ACCESS SERVICE AGREEMENT 
BETWEEN THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT, CONNECTICUT EDUCATION 
NETWORK AND THE TOWN OF HAMDEN   
Motion to open the item was made by Councilman Figlar and seconded by 
Councilwoman Parks.  Vote: All in favor, the motion pass unanimously.
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the committee, Chair Foley adjourned the IT & Civic 
Engagement Committee meeting at 9:12pm.
